30 ANDHRA PRADESH LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY SESSION-II LAQ No.187 (Starred) Notice given by Notice given by Sri Bathula Balaramakrishna, MLA. Smt. Reddappa Gari Madhavi, MLA. Smt. Vemireddy Prashanthi Reddy, MLA. Will the Minister for Home and Disaster Management be pleased to state:- ## QUESTION: a. the number of cases of persons missing and trafficking of women registered between 2019-2024 in the state; the action to be taken by the government to prevent the trafficking of women and young Girls; and b. the action to be taken by the government to implement Friendly Policing effectively. ## Home (Arms) Department ANSWER **a).**Details of missing of persons from the year 2019 to 2024 up to October: Total 78189 missing persons were reported out of which 54122 are women and girls (below 18 years). Details of missing women during this period is given below.
Missing Cases
Year Female
(Including Girls
below 18 years)		 Girls
(Below 18 years)
2019-2024 (Oct) Total 54122 16366
Trafficking of Women from the year 2019 to 2024 up to October: 46 women victims of trafficking were identified during this period and 34 cases were registered. Formation of AHTUs in new Districts: Action to be taken by the government to prevent the trafficking of women and young Girls: • Currently, only 13 Anti-Human Trafficking Units (AHTUs) are established in the original 13 districts, in accordance with G.O.Ms.No.165, Home (PS & CA2) Dept., dated:25.06.2011 and G.O.Ms.No.47, Home (Services-III) Dept., dated:18.05.2021. Following the bifurcation of these 13 districts into 26 districts, 13 additional AHTUs will be established in the newly created districts to effectively combat human trafficking. (Continued...P.2)
